newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one stories.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one stories.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Jan. 6:
WASHINGTON - When Democrats began attacking House Speaker Newt Gingrich more than two years ago, few would have predicted they would be so close to winning.
WASHINGTON - District of Columbia residents are growing impatient and losing confidence in the leadership of Mayor Marion Barry.
TOYKO - Japanese citizens are fed up with bureaucratic corruption and they are suing public officials for squandering tax money.

WASHINGTON - The Parklands apartment village in Southeast Washington has been physically transformed by investments by a private businessman and banks, and the involvement of community organizations and the District government.
